notes: Obscuring Threads (ff8jchay4s, GeneratedMacroCode.php cardActivatedAbilities["ff8jchay4s:0"] builds the MZMAYCHOOSE target list of FATESTONE/FATEBOUND objects on either field; customDQHandlers["ff8jchay4s:0:CardActivated-1"] calls AddTurnEffect($chosen, "SPELLSHROUD")): "Up to one target Fatestone or Fatebound object gains spellshroud until end of turn."
